user.title: UniFi UNAS
user.description: Connects a UniFi NAS (UNAS 2, UNAS Pro …) through UniFi OS. Use a local UniFi OS account (not a UI account with two-factor login). For restart, shutdown and updates the account also needs UniFi OS admin rights.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the UNAS.
data_description.username: Local UniFi OS account with access to UniFi Drive.
data_description.verify_ssl: Off by default: UniFi OS uses a self-signed certificate, so the integration remembers the certificate the UNAS shows at setup and accepts only that one afterwards. Turn on only if the UNAS has a certificate from a trusted authority.

confirm.title: Accept new certificate of {name}?
confirm.description:
The UNAS now shows a different certificate than the one remembered at setup, so the integration stopped sending the login.

Remembered: `{old}`
Now: `{new}`

This is expected after a factory reset, a reinstall of UniFi OS or a new certificate. If you changed nothing, do not accept: another device may be answering at this address. You can compare the fingerprint with the certificate your browser shows for the UNAS.

abort.cannot_connect: The UNAS does not answer. Try again once it is reachable.
